fields.description: Signature of the recipient acknowledging receipt.

fields.description: Linked Bill of Lading or shipment reference.

fields.description: Any extra remarks about the delivery.

document.document_description: A Delivery Receipt (sometimes called a Proof of Delivery) is typically a single-page confirmation that goods shipped have been received by the intended party. It captures essential shipment details and the recipient’s acknowledgment.
